hero.titleHtml: Chapter Four: Alternating Current Circuits AC Circuits
hero.lead: From the sinusoidal wave of alternating current to pure resistance, the inductor, and the capacitor, and from their mixed series circuits to the electrical transformer: in this chapter we study the behavior of each electrical element with alternating current, its effective value, impedance, power factor, and electrical resonance.

objectivesLead: After studying this chapter, the student will be able to know:
objectives: The effective value of the current.
The laws of a pure-resistance circuit.
The laws of a pure inductor in an AC circuit.
The laws of the capacitor and its operation in an AC circuit.
The electrical transformer, its laws, and its types.
